features.title: System Features
features.subtitle: A complete overview of all the tools and technologies integrated into WACalls Chat.

chat.title: Chat & Service
items: Real-time multichannel chat over WhatsApp, with several connections at once
Serving, Waiting and Groups tabs, with unread filter and sorting
Text, image, video, audio and documents — including pasting straight from the clipboard
Voice recording with a live waveform, plus an emoji picker
Private internal notes the customer never sees
Forward, reply (quoting), edit and delete sent messages
Emoji reactions grouped in the conversation
Voice message transcription, searchable by what was said
Search inside the conversation and in the contact panel
Full-screen image viewer with zoom, rotate and download
Typing suggestions based on your own reply history
Start a conversation with a number that never wrote first

productivity.title: Agent Productivity
items: Quick replies (/shortcuts) with dynamic variables — {name}, {ticket} and others
Quick replies with a saved attachment and a usage counter
Scheduled messages and automatic follow-up (cancelled if the customer replies)
Accept, transfer, send back to the queue and close the ticket
Colored tags per conversation
Agent signature toggled per conversation
Close with a reason, bulk close and full ticket timeline
Contact details panel with media, notes and service history
Edit the contact and link the chat to a Kanban card without leaving it
Run an automation flow by hand from inside the conversation

flows.title: Flow Builder (Chatbot)
items: Visual canvas editor: drag a block, draw the arrow, the bot answers
Bound to the connection — the customer's message drops into the chosen flow
Trigger keywords, plus a switch to turn the flow on and off
Interactive buttons and numbered menus, one output per option
Open questions that store the answer in a variable and reuse it anywhere
If/Else, weighted randomizer, delay and switch to another flow
Send images, audio, video and documents from inside the flow
Add or remove tags, route to a queue or to a specific agent
HTTP request and n8n webhook as blocks of the flow itself
Warning for outputs with no destination, where the conversation would stall
Built-in simulator: run the whole conversation before publishing
Duplicate a flow to build variations without starting over

campaigns.title: Media Campaigns
items: One message to many contacts, with text, image, audio, video or document
Pick contacts by tag, from the list, from a CSV sheet or from recent chats
Automatic rotation across connected numbers, so no single one carries it all
Randomized delay between sends instead of a burst
Hourly and daily send caps per number
Progressive warm-up for a new number
Time window and weekdays — nothing goes out at 3 a.m.
Personalization with {name} and other contact variables
Duration estimate before starting, and live progress
Pause, resume and follow sent, queued and failed, with the reason for each failure

kanban.title: Pipeline (Kanban)
items: Several boards with ready-made templates (Service, Sales, Support), created in one click
Drag and drop between columns — and even between different boards
Per-column SLA with a visual overdue alert
Cards with due date and owner, linked straight to the chat and the contact

connections.title: Connections & Contacts
items: Several WhatsApp connections at once, switched from the header
Pair by scanning the QR code, with step-by-step instructions on screen
Account health check: state, JID, name and platform
Rename, restart, disconnect and delete a connection
Receive or ignore group messages, connection by connection
Turn call receiving and call recording on or off per connection
Bind a chatbot flow and a queue to each connection
Contact book with search, photo, create, edit and copy number
Contacts and photos from WhatsApp showing up in the book on their own

telephony.title: Telephony & VoIP
items: Built-in dialer with real WhatsApp calls (E.164 numbers)
Floating dialer with keypad, contact book and call history
Caller ID with photo and name synced from the contact
Incoming call ringing on screen, to answer or decline
Dial straight from the Contacts screen and from the conversation header
Microphone mute during the call
Floating active-call bar on any screen of the system
Switch to record upcoming calls, with an audio player and a secure download link

queues.title: Queues & Routing
items: Service queues with color and automatic distribution (round-robin, least busy, random or manual)
Maximum simultaneous tickets per agent
Business hours per connection or per queue, with timezone, holidays and an out-of-hours auto message
Each user only sees the queues and connections that concern them

reports.title: Reports & Metrics
items: Dashboard with call and service KPIs, charts by period (7/30/90 days)
Filter by connection and period, with charts for calls, messages and tickets
SLA panel by queue, connection and agent — first response, resolution and % of target met
Alert for conversations at risk of breaching the SLA
Agent ranking and the most frequent closing reasons
Satisfaction survey (CSAT) per agent
Call recordings to play right there or download through a temporary link

admin.title: Administration
items: Full user management, roles (admin/agent) and granular per-module permissions
Each user with a photo, signature name and access limited to their queues and connections
Promote to admin and demote to agent, with an at-least-one-admin guard
Auditable history of role changes (who promoted or demoted whom, and when)
SMTP setup for password recovery, with a test send
"Forgot my password" by e-mail and reset by link, ending the old sessions

whitelabel.title: White label
items: Your own brand: name, colors (light/dark), icon color, logos, favicon and splash screen
Live preview of the browser tab, splash, sidebar and buttons
Restore the default look at any time
Menu items and features shown according to the contracted plan

platform.title: Interface & Platform
items: Light and dark mode, switched from the account menu
Four languages — Portuguese, English, Spanish and Arabic, with right-to-left layout
Notification bell with unread count and a sound alert for new messages
Collapsible sidebar, drawer menu on mobile and a full-screen button
Live updates without reloading the page
A friendly error screen, with reload, when something goes wrong
